'''Pajro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geologist Pajro appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Pre-order crystal vendor on the Imperial fleet.<ref name="SWTOR" />
